title: Mom Arrested After Busting Her 15-Year-Old Son's Lip During A Fight
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 18th, 2023. A woman called 911 regarding her and her 15-year-old son getting into a physical fight. The woman stated that when she came home, her son got aggravated due to the lack of food in the house which led to the fight. During the fight, her son got a busted lip and was bleeding, but she stated that she never hit him and didn't know how he got it. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
